ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 1:8 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions located at the distal tips of both lobes; additional discrete high-contrast focal spots mapped to the medial and distal zones of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 145 degrees; notch depth is approximately 8% of the total fluke vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks/valleys) along the full trailing edge; notable increase in amplitude at the distal-left margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep from median notch to distal tips; symmetrical upward curvature towards the terminal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially clustered high-intensity circular patterns at distal tips (left and right) and scattered across the mid-section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) mapped to the right lobe, predominantly with diagonal orientations relative to the horizontal fluke axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged indentations and small missing segments along the trailing edge of the left lobe distal to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense white speckling pattern localized in the center-right quadrant of the visible ventral surface.
